sections.text:
# Cannon School — Summer Programs Research (2026)

Provenance header
- Compiled: August 11, 2026, for the Summer Programs research-area build (two cards:
 The Camp Catalog, The Summer Cost Planner).
- Method: the school's camp page shows its brochure only as an Issuu embed with no
 downloadable PDF, and Issuu's text APIs are locked. The 80 page images were pulled
 from Issuu's CDN and read directly, so every figure below comes from the brochure
 pages themselves, not from an aggregator's summary.
- Primary source: the official **2026 Camp Cannon Brochure (80 pp.)**, published by
 Cannon School on Issuu 2026-02-20 and embedded on the school's Camp Cannon page.
 Every figure is copied char-for-char from that brochure unless marked otherwise.
- Where the school publishes nothing, this file says NOT PUBLISHED rather than
 estimating.
- The school brands the program **Camp Cannon**.

**Seven weeks, June 8 to July 31 (2026).**

| Week | Dates |
| --- | --- |
| Week 1 | June 8 - 12 |
| Week 2 | June 15 - 18 (4-day week) |
| Week 3 | June 22 - 26 |
| Week 4 | July 6 - 10 |
| Week 5 | July 13 - 17 |
| Week 6 | July 20 - 24 |
| Week 7 | July 27 - July 31 |

Two closures: **June 19 (Juneteenth)** and the full week of **June 29-July 3**.

Session hours, uniform across the catalog:
- Morning: 9:00 - 12:00
- Afternoon: 1:00 - 4:00
- All Day: 9:00 - 4:00

**Wrap-around care: earliest drop-off 7:30 AM, latest pickup 5:30 PM** — a 10-hour
span. Drop-off windows: Before Care 7:30 AM - 8:30 AM; AM and Full-day campers
8:30 AM - 8:50 AM (morning assembly 8:50 AM); Lunch Care/Service 11:50 AM -12 AM
(*sic* — the brochure has a typo here; means 12 PM); PM campers 12:30 PM -12:50 PM
(afternoon assembly 12:50 PM). Pickup: AM without lunch care 11:50 PM - 12:00 PM
(*sic*, another typo for AM); PM campers 4:00 PM - 4:15 PM; after care 4:15 PM -
5:30 PM. Snack break 10:15 - 10:45.

Location: Cannon School, 5801 Poplar Tent Rd., Concord, NC.

Facilities: "65-acre campus along Coddle Creek" with "top-tier athletic facilities and
inspiring learning environments." The fuller list the school publishes elsewhere:
state-of-the-art classroom facilities, a performing arts center, two gymnasiums, a
dance studio, a strength and conditioning center, athletic fields, track, tennis
courts, and wooded wetlands.

Off-campus travel is noted per camp (e.g. *We're Going to the Park* visits a different
Concord park each day; *Adventure Camp* traveled to the US National Whitewater Center
and Crowders Mountain in 2024 — TO VERIFY for 2026).

Staffing/safety: Cannon School Registered Nurses and a certified Athletic Trainer
on-site during camp sessions; all instructors undergo background checks. Director of
Auxiliary Programs is Nick Knauer.

**251 total camp-week offerings across the 7 weeks** (Week 1: 38, Week 2: 34, Week 3:
40, Week 4: 39, Week 5: 39, Week 6: 40, Week 7: 35), representing roughly **180
distinct camp titles**. All camps run Mon–Fri (Week 2 is Mon–Thu, 4 days).

The school's own five category labels: `STEM & Academics`, `Visual Arts`,
`Performance Arts`, `Culinary`, `Sports & Games`. There is no separate "traditional day
camp" tier — the closest equivalents are *Classic Summer Fun*, *Busy Bees Active
Adventures*, *Field Day Every Day* and *Super Sports Sampler*.

A representative sample across every category, price tier and week follows; the full
251-row catalog is in the brochure's own "Camp Planning Workbook" (pp. 5–11).

| Snacks | $1.00 each |

**A change from 2024 worth flagging**, since older aggregator pages still circulate the
old terms: in 2024 the lunch *hour* itself was free ("we offer lunch care from 12 p.m.
to 1 p.m. at no additional cost") and only the food cost $34 per week. For 2026 the
lunch hour is itself a paid add-on at $25.

One-time fees:
- **Membership fee: ($50), non-refundable.** (In 2024 this was a $25 "Registration
 fee" — the name and the amount both changed.)
- Camp Cannon camper shirts: ($15), purchasable during registration.
- Transfer/change fee on or after May 15, 2026: $25 per transaction.

Deposit policy: "An initial 50% deposit is due at the time of registration to secure
your child's spot in a session. The remaining payment is due by May 15, 2026." Online
registration requires a deposit by credit card, debit card or electronic check.

**Sibling / multi-week discounts: NOT PUBLISHED.** The 2026 brochure contains no
sibling, multi-week, or bulk discount of any kind. The only price break is the
structural one for the 4-day Week 2. Financial aid for camp is also not mentioned.

sections.text:
- **Registration opens: Sunday, February, 15, 2026 - 8:00 p.m.** (transcribed exactly,
 including the brochure's stray comma). The contents page states it more loosely as
 "Registration begins February 15th". The 2024 season opened at 12 am on Feb. 15 —
 the 2026 season moved to an 8:00 p.m. opening.
- Registration URL: www.cannonschool.org/camp; the underlying system is
 campcannon.campmanagement.com. "Credit and debit cards and bank draft are accepted
 for online registrations only." The 2026 brochure has no paper registration form —
 the 2024 edition had mail-in Forms A and B at the back; those are gone.
- **Open to non-Cannon families: YES, explicitly.** "Open to all children ages 4 to 18,
 Camp Cannon welcomes participants from public and independent schools, home-schooled
 students, and those visiting Concord for the summer!" Two camps are the exception by
 design — *Jump Into Cannon* is an orientation program (in 2024 it was labeled "New
 Cannon Students Only") and *Ready, Set, First Grade*.
- Cancellation / refund: "The membership fee of ($50) is non-refundable. Session
 deposits are fully refunded if the cancellation is made before May 15, 2026. On or
 after May 15, 2026, NO refunds are offered." If Camp Cannon cancels a session for low
 enrollment and no alternative is chosen, a full refund is given.
- Changes/transfers: free before May 15, 2026; $25 per transaction on or after, unless
 the camp was canceled.
- **Sell-out patterns:** "Camps fill up fast!" and "Each camp session has a minimum
 number of campers required to run the session, as well as a maximum number of campers
 who can be accepted. The number varies for each session. Some popular camps fill very
 shortly after registration opens." Specific per-camp caps, minimums, and which camps
 historically sell out are NOT PUBLISHED.
- Age policy: "campers must be fully potty trained to attend due to camp and school
 policy." Only camps matching a child's age/grade appear during online registration.

Official Cannon School sources:
- https://www.cannonschool.org/cannon-life/camp-cannon — the Camp Cannon landing page (season overview, registration links, contact)
- https://issuu.com/cannonschool/docs/camp_cannon_brochure_summer_2026 — **the 2026 Camp Cannon Brochure, 80 pp., published by Cannon School 2026-02-20. Source for essentially every figure above.** Key pages: p. 3 (dates/times/care hours), p. 4 (week schedule), pp. 5–11 (Camp Planning Workbook — the full per-week catalog with categories, ages, costs), p. 12 (contents), pp. 15–74 (camp descriptions by category), p. 75 (registration Q&A, opening date, deposit), p. 76 (cancellation, transfers, drop-off/pickup, merchandise), p. 77 (lunch, snacks, medication, extended-day pricing), p. 78 (lunch and snacks detail)
- https://e.issuu.com/embed.html?d=camp_cannon_brochure_summer_2026&u=cannonschool — the embed the school's page uses
- https://image.isu.pub/260220205754-c7a24d00a7b9f9dfe63caa5797d4b987/jpg/page_N.jpg — direct page images of that brochure (N = 1..80), which is how it was read
- https://www.cannonschool.org/fs/comms-manager/view/fe3cf677-048c-4267-b211-a632107095c5 — official Camp Cannon **Week 5 (July 13-17, 2026) orientation email**. Corroborates 2026 operations and adds: Before Care 7:30 a.m. – 8:30 a.m., Lunch 12:00 p.m. - 12:30 p.m., After Care 4:15 p.m. – 5:30 p.m., Slushy Friday $1 each, Camp Director Nick Knauer, Office Manager Alexandra Godinez (704-721-7182). **Caution: its lunch window (12:00–12:30) and before-care end (8:30) differ from the brochure's (12:00–1:00 and 9:00)** — the brochure times are the published policy; the email reflects that week's actual operation.
- https://campcannon.campmanagement.com/p/request_for_info_m.php?action=enroll — new-family registration (live 2026 enrollment form)
- https://resources.finalsite.net/images/v1706807143/cannonschoolorg/sbxzygib5bvaqhs6kpf6/CampCannon2024BrochurewithcoversandMasterScheduleincluded-1152024.pdf — the **2024** brochure. Used only for the year-over-year comparisons explicitly flagged above (2024 registration fee $25, lunch care free + $34/week food, $27 for the 4-day week, seven weeks June 10th through August 2nd). **Do not cite its prices as current.**

Contact for anything marked NOT PUBLISHED: CampCannon@cannonschool.org / 704-721-7198.

**Non-official sources consulted and NOT relied on for any figure:** ActivityHero,
Kidvoyage, charlottesummercamper.com, KidsOutAndAbout, BroadwayWorld. Several
advertise "2026 prices" while showing older data; everything above comes from the
school's own brochure instead.

### Items explicitly NOT PUBLISHED

Sibling discounts, multi-week discounts, camp financial aid, per-camp enrollment
caps/minimums, and which specific camps sell out.

### TO VERIFY

The 2026 off-campus destinations for *Adventure Camp* (2024 listed the US National
Whitewater Center and Crowders Mountain; the 2026 workbook entry was read but not its
full description page).
